page.overview:
Who is Agara?

Agara had a short crop of spiky black hair and small black eyes.

Agara was on a mission with two other Takigakure shinobi when Kabuto Yakushi infiltrated their ranks. He and his cell-mates then began to chase after him. Afterwards, Agara was attacked and had his neck snapped by Kabuto so that the latter could test his new powers. When Anko Mitarashi found his body, it led her to the Mountains' Graveyard.
